name: Jinrui-nsmd
manufacturer: Shenzhen Jinrui Electronic Material Co., Ltd.
title: JK-nSMD050-30: 0.5 A hold, 30 V resettable PPTC fuse in 1206
summary: A polymer positive-temperature-coefficient (PPTC) resettable fuse in a 1206 surface-mount body. It holds 0.50 A and trips at 1.00 A, both at 25 °C, and is rated for DC circuits of up to 30.0 V. Fault current up to 100 A is rated, and at 8.0 A it trips within 0.10 s. It is meant for occasional faults, not for circuits that trip repeatedly or stay tripped for long periods.

operation.text: Exceeding the voltage or current ratings can damage the device and may cause arcing or flame. It suits occasional overcurrent or overtemperature faults; circuits where faults repeat often or the device would stay tripped for long periods are outside its intended use. A large inductance in the protected path can produce an L·di/dt voltage above the 30 V rating when the device trips.

The polymer expands as it heats, so the body should not be clamped, pressed or fitted into a space that stops it expanding. Silicone-based oils and some aggressive solvents degrade the polymer; ordinary board cleaning methods are acceptable.

Reflow by infrared, vapour phase, hot air or nitrogen-atmosphere lead-free ovens to the profile in the reflow table. Wave soldering on the underside of the board is not supported. Solder paste is at most 0.25 mm (0.010 inch) thick. Exceeding the profile can leave the device outside its ratings. Terminals are tin over nickel-copper and pass solderability to EIA RS 186-9E and to Category 3 of ANSI/J-STD-002.

Keep stock at no more than 38 °C, where warmer storage can deform the packaging, and at no more than 60 % relative humidity, since heat with moisture oxidises the terminal plating and lowers solderability. Keep parts in sealed bags with desiccant until use, away from air carrying sulphur or chlorine compounds.

notes: The top face carries the marking JG.
